_comment: TEST DATA ONLY, for Phase 2 'four phones can play a desk race' (doc §13). Self-checked challenge types only (trivia/observation/puzzle/navigation/qr) - photo and interaction types need Phases 4-5 (capture + AI judging) and are not usable yet. Not tied to real GPS coordinates or real Barcelona locations. Time caps are shortened from the doc's 8-minute default so the skip flow can be exercised in a short desk test.

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 1
checkpoints.instruction: What is the capital of Catalonia?

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 2
checkpoints.clue: Look around the room you are sitting in.
checkpoints.instruction: How many legs does a standard table have?

checkpoints.name: Desk checkpoint 4
checkpoints.instruction: This is checkpoint 4 of 5. Which checkpoint number comes next?
